# MCP Tool Reference

<!-- This file is generated by scripts/generate_tools_doc.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

All 25 tools exposed by `memorycore` via the MCP protocol.
Tools are listed in registration order from `memorycore/server.py`.
Errors are caught by `@_safe_tool` and returned as JSON objects.

## Tools

### `memory_add`

Add a structured memory record to local SQLite memory.

**Returns:** `dict[str, Any]`

| Parameter | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `type` | `str` | **required** |
| `title` | `str` | **required** |
| `content` | `str` | **required** |
| `scope` | `str` | `'global'` |
| `tags` | `list[str] \| str \| None` | `None` |
| `source` | `str` | `'manual'` |
| `source_agent` | `str` | `'agent'` |
| `project_path` | `str` | `''` |
| `confidence` | `float` | `0.7` |
| `importance` | `float` | `0.5` |
| `status` | `str` | `'active'` |
| `decay_policy` | `str` | `'review'` |
| `related_ids` | `list[str] \| str \| None` | `None` |
| `metadata` | `dict[str, Any] \| None` | `None` |
| `valid_from` | `str \| None` | `None` |
| `valid_until` | `str \| None` | `None` |
| `atomize` | `str \| bool` | `'auto'` |

| Parameter | Type | Default |

| `query` | `str` | `''` |
| `types` | `list[str] \| str \| None` | `None` |

| `tags` | `list[str] \| str \| None` | `None` |
| `status` | `str` | `'active'` |
| `limit` | `int` | `10` |

### `memory_context`

Return a compact context pack for a task, grouped by memory class.

**Returns:** `dict[str, Any]`

| Parameter | Type | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `task` | `str` | **required** |
| `agent` | `str` | `'agent'` |

| `token_budget` | `int` | `2000` |
| `retrieval_mode` | `str` | `'strict'` |
| `prefer_atomic` | `bool` | `True` |
| `include_parent` | `bool` | `False` |

### `memory_vector_status`

Return Qdrant vector store status (availability, collection, count).

**Returns:** `dict[str, Any]`

No parameters.
